experiment: C4 two-level recursive Canaria composition tree
procedure: fit six local candidates to original local teacher activations
jointly adapt all six local candidates to original a0->a6 span and freeze
one-level control: fit matched single only to adapted-six-cluster outputs
fit three pair Canarias only to internal activation maps of the frozen adapted-six cluster
jointly adapt the three pair Canarias only to adapted-six-cluster final outputs and freeze
fit final matched single only to frozen pair-cluster outputs
fit direct matched single on original a0->a6 as control
recursive_teacher_isolation: After the six-candidate cluster is jointly adapted and frozen, original a6 is forbidden as a fit target for pair-local fits, pair-cluster joint adaptation, one-level recursive single, and two-level final single.
validation_endpoints: adapted six-cluster NMSE vs original teacher and validation accuracy
one-level recursive single NMSE vs adapted-six teacher and original teacher, validation accuracy
pair-cluster NMSE vs adapted-six teacher and original teacher, validation accuracy
two-level final single NMSE vs pair-cluster teacher, adapted-six teacher, original teacher, validation accuracy
direct original single NMSE and validation accuracy
interpretation_boundary: Exploratory recursive-depth test only. No held-out test evaluation, no confirmatory PASS rule, and no arbitrary-depth hierarchical-compiler claim.
